visual_action: A fast-paced montage showing Donald Trump dancing on a stage at sunset and speaking at a podium. This is followed by a series of clips including: an NFL player making a one-handed catch, a bull rider, large crowds waving American flags, an underwater scene, an empty football stadium, a firefighter spraying a hose, a basketball player shooting, a person on horseback carrying a large American flag at night, and a bald eagle in flight.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is the first person shown in the video, seen dancing on stage and speaking at a podium.

cast.name: National Football League (NFL)
cast.evidence: The NFL logo is visible on the 50-yard line of a football field shown in the montage.

on_screen_text.text: The greatest nation on earth for 250 years
NEW ENGLAND HAS ... UNITED WE STAND!

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video. The only audio is a song with sung lyrics.
audio_music: An upbeat, inspirational, and anthemic electronic remix of the song 'Sweet Disposition' by The Temper Trap plays consistently throughout the entire video, driving the montage forward and creating a feeling of grandeur.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with rapid cuts between different inspirational and patriotic clips.
central_claim: America, represented by figures like Donald Trump and symbols of strength and patriotism, has been the world's greatest nation for 250 years.
intended_effect: To evoke strong feelings of national pride and inspiration, and to associate these emotions with Donald Trump.
